name: plan
description: Turn a piece of work into phases and steps: today's code with file paths, phases that each end in something reviewable, steps that leave the tree working and how each is checked, what is out of scope, and what is unclear with who must answer. Also reviews a written plan against the repository and the request, challenges it with one agent per way it can fail, and records the answers to its open questions. Use before starting work, on work somebody else designed, when work needs stages but one owner, or when a plan needs checking before anyone builds on it. Triggers on: "plan this ticket", "implementation plan", "plan this in phases", "review this plan", "check this plan", "challenge this plan", "record the answers in the plan", "/atk:plan".

findings.excerpt: /atk:plan <ticket>             # Plan from a ticket in the detected tracker
